checks.tolerance: Compilation and resource bundling only; signing, notarization and clean-user installation are separate tasks (T-T02).

Headless startup must exit before NSApplication finishes launching and still deliver the deferred focus sample; a nonzero exit or a missing report fails this check. The adapter report and focus events are capture-only (A06): the Maker app capture to IKKOKU_AUTOCAPTURE is what ends the run, and the app rejects the report without it. The PNG is the default Maker frame and only proves the run completed.

Runs the Debug app so the Studio source-pose inspector writes the report at IKKOKU_CAPTURE_UI_REPORT, which must then validate (see studio-inspector-validate). IKKOKU_MAKER_LIBRARY=none keeps a developer's optional converted Maker library (found through the source-tree fallback) out of the synthetic scene's import; with it, the synthetic character imported as no source character and nothing was selected (2026-10-23). The window PNG is hashed only to prove the capture wrote a nonempty file (the app itself verifies it decodes at the captured size, A-T05); cacheDisplay omits most SwiftUI content (ST-D07), so the PNG is not inspector evidence.
Validates the report produced by studio-inspector-capture; until the PR #5 app hooks exist, nothing writes that JSON, so this check fails on the absent report — exactly as intended.

Builds the optimized app that release-startup-capture launches. The flags match the CI release-package job, except that signing stays on. Debug lanes cannot catch optimizer-only faults: on 2026-10-23 every Release render crashed while all Debug lanes passed (R6, FrameRing.allocate(array:)).

Release smoke: renders the bundled public Maker character once and exits 0 with a nonempty PNG. Source-tree fallbacks are off and the saved converted library is ignored in an automated run, so only bundled assets are used and no fixture is needed. Before the R6 fix (2026-10-23, Xcode 27.0 / Swift 6.4) this run crashed with SIGSEGV in Renderer.prepare on the first skinned frame. The PNG proves only that one optimized frame rendered and was written; it is not a visual reference.

Runs the FrameRing tests optimized; a cold build takes about four minutes. frameRingArrayAllocationReachesAThrowingCallerWithoutAnError calls allocate(array:) from a throwing caller. Before the R6 fix, this release run ended with signal 11; the Debug suite passed. GPU cases need a Metal device.
